sentences.en: This farmer relies on beneficial insects for pest control.
sentences.zh: 这位农民依靠有益昆虫来进行害虫防治。

sentences.en: Twenty million dollars are spent each year to fight this parasitic pest.
sentences.zh: 每年花费两亿美元来对抗这种寄生害虫。

sentences.en: An uninvited guest is worse than a pest.
sentences.zh: 不速之客比害虫还糟糕。

senses.zh: 害虫，有害动物；<非正式>讨厌的人（或物）

mnemonic: 联想记忆：“拍死它”→见到害虫就拍死它→害虫
